The '''Kuthic Worlds'''<ref name="TEA" /> were a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Talcene Transit/Legends|Talcene Transit]] connected the group of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to the larger [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] as well as the [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] traveled along the Talcene Transit in order to deliver cargo from the Perlemian to the Kuthic Worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kuthic Worlds were first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed them in grid square S-8.<ref name="TEA" />
